items.subject: A single compact work desk, honey-oak rectangular top, four slender matte sage steel legs, one dark charcoal desktop monitor on a simple stand, one slim charcoal keyboard and mouse. No laptop, divider panel or second monitor.
A sage-gray upholstered office swivel chair with slim ergonomic backrest, seat, two armrests, matte dark metal five-star caster base. Realistic slender proportions, no padded executive throne.
A low wide honey-oak document bookcase with two shelves and solid side panels, a few cream/sage unlabelled binders and books, tidy restrained arrangement, no readable spines.
A compact broad-leaf monstera in a plain warm cream ceramic pot, natural sage-green lobed leaves and slender stems, upright compact silhouette.
